workResult: Completed Skill 03 source-complete Deep Reading for all three same-date selected objects after ordered Runtime authority and Worker Claimed were durably established. Q-20260821-01 verified that Codex explicitly classifies FunctionCallOutput items without call_id as possible external context; under memories.disable_on_external_context, demonstrated injection and fork handling can durably mark thread memory mode polluted, while Guardian/general transcripts preserve named tool-source identity and recent-image selection can still reuse unpaired output images. This is a structural provenance and memory-policy boundary, not proof that all tool output is unsafe, that source identity is authenticated, or that every downstream memory consumer is protected. Q-20260821-02 verified that Google ADK deliberately reverted an A2A-transport-based HITL confirmation guard because it rejected legitimate operator confirmations carried over A2A while leaving equivalent approval ingress through other paths; issue #6461 is explicitly reopened and the selected commit adds no replacement principal-bound authorization mechanism. This demonstrates that transport provenance alone is not approval authority, not that the underlying A2A/HITL authorization problem is solved. Q-20260821-03 verified published Claude Code v2.1.238 behavior separating two MCP helper controls: project/agent inline execution is workspace-trust gated, while project .mcp.json, plugin and agent-file headersHelper commands are documented as running without inherited credential environment variables; official MCP documentation independently confirms headersHelper is shell execution used to mint connection headers and project/local helpers are trust gated. The public implementation source, exact stripped-variable list and complete regression matrix are not disclosed, so those details remain Unknown rather than inferred. Three durable Reading Notes were produced. No Research Analysis, article drafting, visualization or publication was performed.
workResult_zh: 仅在有序 Runtime 执行权与 Worker Claimed 均完成持久建立后，才对三个同日已选对象完成 Skill 03 Source-complete Deep Reading。Q-20260821-01 核验了 Codex 明确把缺少 call_id 的 FunctionCallOutput 判定为可能的 External Context；在 memories.disable_on_external_context 启用时，已展示的注入与 Fork 处理路径可把 Thread Memory Mode 持久标记为 polluted，同时 Guardian/通用 Transcript 保留命名 Tool Source Identity，Recent-image Selection 仍可复用未配对输出中的图像。该结论证明的是结构化来源边界与 Memory Policy 边界，不是“所有 Tool Output 都不安全”，也不是“来源身份已认证”或“所有下游 Memory Consumer 都受保护”。Q-20260821-02 核验了 Google ADK 主动回退基于 A2A Transport 的 HITL Confirmation Guard，因为该门禁会拒绝经 A2A 承载的合法 Operator Confirmation，同时仍无法阻止从其他入口到达的等价 Approval；Issue #6461 已明确重新打开，且所选提交没有增加替代性的 Principal-bound Authorization Mechanism。该证据证明的是 Transport Provenance 不能单独等同于审批权限，而不是底层 A2A/HITL 授权问题已经解决。Q-20260821-03 核验了 Claude Code v2.1.238 已发布行为中两个彼此独立的 MCP Helper 控制：Project/Agent Inline Execution 受 Workspace Trust 门禁约束，而 Project .mcp.json、Plugin 与 Agent-file 的 headersHelper 被公开说明为不继承 Credential Environment Variables；官方 MCP 文档也独立确认 headersHelper 属于可生成连接 Header 的 Shell Execution，Project/Local Helper 受 Trust Gate 约束。公开材料未披露实现源码、准确剥离的变量清单与完整 Regression Matrix，因此这些细节保持 Unknown，不做推断。共形成 3 份持久 Reading Note。未执行 Research Analysis、文章写作、可视化或发布。
